rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin; a box is the screen bounding box of its 8 projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]
rules.floor: the kitchen is built round the old picture: a place keeps its screen place, its world point the surface under it (estufa-set.html surfaceAt): the stool's top, a top of the run (z 1.3), the shelf, or the floor (z 0). A frog place q: under (q.x + 16, q.y + 26); a person's or a thing's place (x, y): under (x, y - 1). So every position of estufa.js, its stories and its pairs keeps its numbers, but those in moves and the story positions remap moves; the sheet names each (spots, remap, code)
rules.relative: what the old code draws or moves relative to a person, the frog, a pot, a plate or a counter's place (what is carried, the steam, the flames, the helpings, the pieces on a plate, the bubbles, the clouds) keeps its offsets
rules.view: one view, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window from x0 22, the old wide one
rules.pair: a review or level picture is pictures[word.side]: zoom 2 = the 98 x 52 crop shown at 2 x 2, zoom 1 = the 196 x 104 window. The old rectangles (remap cam and crop) say which pictures they were

layout.what: La cocina's room (cocina-kit.js) cut open as La sala's, on the world's axes at the engine's 30 degrees: one run along the back wall, the left counter from the corner, the stove, the right counter running off the picture at the right; the shelf with its jars over the left counter, the hood and a steel splashback over the stove, the window with its bush over the right counter; the stool on the floor in front of the stove; the checker floor; dark above the cut walls
layout.why: the brief: the stove and the two counters in one run along one axis against a far wall. A run along x falls half a row a pixel to the right; it is placed as low as the right cook (LADO[1], 171, 176) lets it (whoever stands at the run is on clear floor in front of it, its front 1.4 from the wall), so the stove's pots and the right counter's things move least and the left counter's most (moves). Its tops are 1.4 deep (the kit's counters are 0.9) so that the tray, 46 px wide, and the plates stand wholly on them. The stove is as wide as two 34 px pots side by side need, in the kit's look

behind.what: nothing: the outside (sky, bush) is baked into the window

setKey.bakedWhy: order 06 found 164 states made by fourteen keys. One is the set's: banco (the stool; the review pictures leave it out). The other thirteen are things the sprite layer draws, as the old: basura and cubo (the waste bucket and what lies in it), der and izq (what stands on the counters), encima (on the frog's head), estante (the sack and the jar on the shelf), fuegos (the pots and the pan, their contents, flames, steam and smoke), mat (the frog's plate), olor (the smell), plata (abuela's plate), repisa (the plates put by), salero (the shaker), ventanacome (the plates on the sill). So setKey reads banco only
